_about: Marks drawn before task titles, one per coding agent, so tasks from different agents tell apart at a glance. They are original marks, not the agents' logos (those are their makers' trademarks). "id" is the agent id the service puts on each task (view.agent, the source's id in src/sources/<agent>/). Coordinates are in a box of [width, height]; "paths" are SVG path strings (M L H V C Q Z, absolute or relative; no arcs), filled with "color" (#RRGGBB, system:<name> or primary). Add a mark by adding an entry.
